con Neo4j la consola no admite CALL, SHO: with Neo4j the console does not accept CALL, SHOW, USE, LOAD or TERMINATE: the brains share the database
con Neo4j la consola no admite comentari: with Neo4j the console does not accept comments: remove them from the query
con Neo4j la consola no admite parámetro: with Neo4j the console does not accept parameters ($): write the values in the query
con Neo4j la consola no admite relacione: with Neo4j the console does not accept variable-length relationships or quantified paths: their intermediate nodes cannot be kept inside the brain
con Neo4j la consola no sabe limitar est: with Neo4j the console cannot keep this pattern inside the brain, so it does not run it: {{detail}}
con Neo4j la consola solo admite caracte: with Neo4j the console only accepts ASCII characters outside strings, no backslashes, and no \u escape
con Neo4j la consola solo admite las fun: with Neo4j the console only accepts Neo4j's own functions, not {{detail}}: none from a plugin such as APOC
